other_conditions: Applicant must own at least 1.5 hectares of land at a single location (individual farmers)
In Scheduled Tribe areas, minimum land requirement is 0.5 hectares at one location
Group applications require a collective ownership of at least 5 hectares by 10 or more farmers
The group's land boundaries must lie within the specified perimeter
benefits_summary: Subsidy of up to 60% (capped ₹48,000) for small/marginal farmers, 50% (capped ₹40,000) for other farmers, and 70% (capped ₹56,000 per farmer) for group applications, covering up to 400 m of fencing per farmer
